变态的词条效果（变态的词条效果（第22页）“我不回去！”宁浩才不会说回去呢，他要是说回去了，保准石大个下一秒就收回拳头了。“师门建山门于唐朝，算算时间你也是唐朝时期成精的，你是本地山中的树精么？”李修远问道。钟晋云反复地将自己被萧祁碾压的画面在脑中回放，一次又一次，每一次都更为痛苦，每一次都更让自己沉浸。作为帝国的首都，这里肯定会混着各种各样的人员，其中肯定会有敌人的间谍，而间谍使用无线电和外界联系，是再正常不过的了。最初的时候，德国使用的还是老旧的电子管的无线电，耗电量大，体积大，操作复杂，每一级的通信都需要切换频率，所以导致了还需要一个专门的无线电员，德国的五人制的坦克班，是配备最齐全的。但此时那些强者无疑萌生了死志，他们一生为了世界的光明而战，因此融入白浩的身体，才会那么的无怨无悔。那人转身没转完全，便立刻按照原来的轨迹转了回来，然后就是翻身跳投，让钟晋云措手不及。只不过一会儿的功夫，白浩又发现了这么一堆奇异的骨头。这些黑色的骨头，根本看不出来是什么生物的。乍一看去，不知道的人还以为是黑岩石呢？在这闹哄哄的球场中，穆尚天刚要启动，便听到了来自对手的问候。一棵棵巨树折断，呼啸着砸落，林间一个长达二十米的巨大蜥蜴在林间翻腾，巨大的眸子冰冷无比，此时眸中却有着一种骇然。我点了点头，闭目等待了起来，巫海则是吩咐几人走了卧室，开始破开墙壁。公寓的屋门再次被推开，钟灵身穿一身白色的连衣裙走了进来。

Abnormal Entry Effect (Abnormal Entry Effect (Page 22) "I won't go back!" Ning Hao won't say it back. If he does, I'm sure Shi Da Shi will retract his fist in the next second. "The master's gate was built in the Tang Dynasty. Count the time." You also became a spirit during the Tang Dynasty. Are you a tree spirit in the local mountains?" Li Xiuyuan asked. Zhong Jinyun repeatedly replayed the scene of himself being crushed by Xiao Qi in his mind, again and again, each time it was more painful and each time he was more distressed. As the capital of the empire, there will definitely be a variety of people here, including enemy spies, and it is normal for spies to use radios to communicate with the outside world. At the beginning, Germany still used old tube radios, which consumed a lot of power, were large in size, and were complex to operate. Each level of communication required a dedicated radio operator, but the German five-man tank squad was the most fully equipped. At that time, those strong men undoubtedly had the will to die. They had been fighting for the light of the world, so they were so merciless. The man turned around and immediately turned back according to the original trajectory, and then turned over and jumped, catching Zhong Jinyun off guard. After a while, Bai Hao found such a pile of strange bones. It was impossible to tell what kind of creatures they were. At first glance, people who didn't know it thought they were black. Where are the rocks? In this noisy stadium, just as Mu Shangtian was about to start, he heard greetings from his opponents. Giant trees broke and roared down, and a giant lizard with a length of 20 meters writhed in the forest, its huge eyes were cold and cold. Bi, there was a kind of horror in my eyes at this time. I nodded, closed my eyes and waited, while Wu Hai ordered a few people to leave the bedroom and started to open the wall. The door of the apartment was opened again, and Zhong Ling walked in wearing a white dress.
